description: <p class="p1"><span class="s1"><strong>Location : Pune<br>About Team &amp; About Role:</strong></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org.</p> <p>You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup &amp; management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains.</p> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <div <div><strong>Responsibilities</strong><br><br></div> <ul> <li>Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems.</li> <li>Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions.</li> <li>Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought.</li> <li>Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic.</li> <li>Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly.</li> <li>Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed.</li> <li>Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET.</li> <li>Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.).</li> <li>Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature.</li> <li>Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status.</li> </ul> <div><br><strong>Requirements</strong><br><br><strong>Must-have</strong></div> <ul> <li>Strong hands-on programming skills in <strong>Golang</strong>.</li> <li>Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: <strong>OIDC/OAuth 2.0</strong> and <strong>SAML 2.0</strong> — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.</li> <li>Working knowledge of<strong> Active Directory</strong>.</li> <li>Applied cryptography/PKI experience: <strong>X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS</strong>.</li> <li>Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work.</li> <li>Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.</li> <li>Simple, effective written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Nice-to-have</strong></div> <ul> <li>Directory internals (schema, bind operations).</li> <li>HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection).</li> <li>Build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI).</li> <li>Secret-manager internals, Redis, Win32, policy engines.</li> <li>Basic C#/.NET (to maintain the companion app).</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> class="content-conclusion"><h2>Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation</h2> <p>Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.&nbsp;</p> <p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/rubrik-inc/mycompany/verification/">Linkedin</a> | <a href="https://twitter.com/rubrikinc">X (formerly Twitter)</a> | <a href="https://www.instagram.com/rubrikinc/" target="_blank">Instagram</a> |&nbsp;<a href="https://www.rubrik.com">Rubrik.com</a></p> <h2>Inclusion @ Rubrik</h2> <p>At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.</p> <p>Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.</p> <h3>Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:</h3> <ul> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.</p> </li> <li style="line-height: 1;"> <p>Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.</p> </li> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled</h2> <p>Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.</p> <p>Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.&nbsp;</p> <p>Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please contact us at hr@rubrik.com if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.</p> <p><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf" target="_blank">EEO IS THE LAW</a></p> <p><a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/olms/regs/compliance/eo_posters/employeerightsposter2page_19final.pdf" target="_blank">NOTIFICATION OF EMPLOYEE RIGHTS UNDER FEDERAL LABOR LAWS</a></p></div>

<div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p class="p1">With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.</p> <p class="p1">Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.</p> <p class="p1">At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.</p> <p class="p1">Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.</p></div><p class="mb-2 whitespace-pre-wrap"><strong>Reports To</strong> Director - Information Security</p> <p class="mb-2 whitespace-pre-wrap"><strong>About the Role</strong> <br>At ChargePoint, we are building the future of electric mobility. As a Junior Platform Engineer, you will play a critical role in integrating advanced AI and machine learning capabilities into our platform infrastructure. You will help drive innovation by prototyping, testing, and deploying intelligent models that enhance platform security, efficiency, and the overall EV charging experience.</p> <p class="mb-2 whitespace-pre-wrap"><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong> In this role, you will work closely with senior engineering and cross-functional teams to build and maintain data pipelines and machine learning integrations. Your day-to-day will involve writing clean Python code, developing APIs, and automating processes to transition AI solutions from experimentation into staging and production environments. Success in this position means effectively bridging the gap between AI development and platform engineering to deliver scalable, intelligent features.</p> <p class="mb-2 whitespace-pre-wrap"><strong>What You Will Bring to ChargePoint</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Assist</strong>&nbsp;in developing, training, and fine-tuning machine learning, deep learning, and NLP models.</li> <li><strong>Support</strong>&nbsp;senior engineers in designing, building, and maintaining robust data pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Implement</strong>&nbsp;foundational preprocessing, feature engineering, and data validation processes.</li> <li><strong>Contribute</strong>&nbsp;to testing, evaluating, and optimizing model performance for scalability and accuracy.</li> <li><strong>Deploy</strong>&nbsp;machine learning models into staging and production environments under the guidance of senior team members.</li> <li><strong>Write</strong>&nbsp;clean, modular, and well-documented Python code for AI experiments and platform prototypes.</li> <li><strong>Develop</strong>&nbsp;APIs, model inference scripts, and automate small-scale tasks to streamline engineering workflows.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate</strong>&nbsp;with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical deliverables.</li> <li><strong>Research</strong>&nbsp;and stay continuously updated with emerging AI tools, frameworks, and MLOps techniques.</li> </ul> <p class="mb-2 whitespace-pre-wrap"><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>1+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, platform engineering, or relevant academic/internship projects.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>Solid programming skills in Python and foundational ML libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn).</li> <li>Basic understanding of deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li> <li>Exposure to Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), or computer vision projects.</li> <li>Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and model evaluation metrics.</li> <li>Strong analytical problem-solving skills and a highly proactive willingness to learn new technologies.</li> </ul> <p class="mb-2 whitespace-pre-wrap"><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with end-to-end ML projects, hackathons, or applied research work.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).</li> <li>Knowledge of version control (Git), containerization (Docker), or basic MLOps concepts.</li> <li>Understanding of vector databases, embeddings, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.</li> </ul> <p class="mb-2 whitespace-pre-wrap"><strong>Location</strong> Bangalore / Gurgaon / Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.&nbsp;</p> <p>If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company needs, we will contact you directly.</p> <div> <div> <p>ChargePoint is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that welcomes and supports all qualified individuals. In alignment with this commitment, we ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations throughout the employment process.</p> <p>If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to access any other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us at <strong>accommodations@chargepoint.com</strong>.</p> </div> <p>ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer.&nbsp;<br>Applicants only - Recruiting agencies do not contact.</p> </div></div>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About DevRev</strong></span></p> <p>At DevRev, we're building the future of work with <em>Computer</em> – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, <em>Computer</em> unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.</p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <div>As a <strong>Forward Deployed Engineer for Implementation Partners</strong> at DevRev, you will be the technical bridge between DevRev, our implementation partners, and their customers. You will combine strong software engineering, systems integration, applied AI, and customer-facing problem solving to help partners successfully design, build, deploy, and scale solutions on the DevRev platform.<br><br>This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will operate at the intersection of <strong>engineering, solution architecture, partner enablement, product expertise, and delivery</strong>. You will work directly with partners and customers to understand requirements, scope solutions, unblock implementations, and translate complex business workflows into AI agents, integrations, automations, and repeatable vertical solutions.<br>You will own the technical partner journey end to end — from onboarding, enablement, and certification through solutioning, implementation delivery, technical adoption, and ongoing partner success. At the same time, you will build reusable internal tools, frameworks, playbooks, and product capabilities that allow DevRev and its partners to scale across multiple implementations.<br>Success in this role requires strong technical depth, ownership, and presence. You should be comfortable writing production-quality code, designing integrations and data flows, working with APIs and cloud infrastructure, using SQL and observability tools to troubleshoot complex systems, and applying modern AI techniques such as LLMs, RAG, function calling, prompting, and evals.<br>You will also be an <strong>AI-augmented builder</strong>, using tools such as Claude Code, Gemini, and DevRev Computer to accelerate development, investigation, documentation, and delivery while applying sound engineering judgment.<br><br>Ultimately, your role is to make our implementation partners dramatically more effective — helping them deliver faster, solve harder problems, scale across customers, and represent DevRev with technical credibility and confidence.</div> <div><strong>&nbsp;</strong></div> <div><strong>What you'll do</strong> <div> <ul> <li>Client-facing: 50% working directly with external customers and partners.</li> <li>Internal Building &amp; Product SME: 50% building for internal customers (internal stakeholders) and acting as the go-to product expert.</li> <li>Own the End-to-End Implementation Partner Lifecycle: Take ownership across the full implementation-partner lifecycle — partner onboarding, enablement and certification, co-selling and deal support, implementation delivery, and ongoing partner management — covering all partner-related work across every engagement.</li> <li>Build &amp; Run Partner Enablement: Create partner enablement courses and hands-on training materials, track partner progress and engagement through dashboards, and act on those insights to close gaps and drive certification and readiness.</li> <li>Build &amp; Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, skills, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.</li> <li>Build Vertical Solutions: Design and develop industry-specific, vertical solutions (e.g. pharma, financial services, retail) — packaging DevRev's platform into repeatable, domain-tailored offerings that map to real customer use cases.</li> <li>Co-Build Vertical Solutions with Partner PMs &amp; Product Leaders: Work with implementation partners' Product Managers and Product leaders to shape, scope, and co-build vertical solutions — aligning on use cases and priorities and jointly deciding what gets built.</li> <li>Scale Horizontally Across Partner Implementations: Support multiple partner implementations in parallel — reusing frameworks, playbooks, and solutions to drive delivery across many engagements at once rather than one at a time.</li> <li>Be the Face of DevRev: Represent DevRev as the technical face in partner calls — and sometimes directly in customer calls — building trust, guiding decisions, and owning the technical relationship.</li> <li>Unblock Everything: Solve both technical and non-technical blockers across partner implementations, keeping delivery moving and stepping in wherever a project is stuck.</li> <li>Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless one-way and two-way data flow.</li> <li>Build for Internal Stakeholders: Design and ship internal tools, agents, and automations that make DevRev's own field, delivery, and go-to-market teams faster and more effective.</li> <li>Product SME: Serve as the subject-matter expert on the DevRev platform — the go-to person internal teams and partners rely on for deep product, integration, and agent guidance.</li> <li>Close the Product Feedback Loop: Turn field learnings into structured product input — filing issues and enhancements, and partnering with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap and unblock delivery.</li> <li>Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.</li> <li>Scope &amp; Estimate: Run requirements gap analysis, solution design, and effort estimation so partner and delivery teams start with a clear, grounded plan.</li> <li>Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer and delivery decision-making.</li> <li>Prototype &amp; Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.</li> <li>Manage Stakeholders &amp; Cross-functional Alignment: Manage expectations across partner, customer, and internal stakeholders, and keep tight communication loops with engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.</li> <li>Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide partners through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.</li> </ul> </div> <div><strong>What you'll bring</strong> <div> <ul> <li>Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.</li> <li>Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.</li> <li>Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)</li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.</li> <li>Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.</li> <li>Cloud &amp; Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).</li> <li>Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.</li> <li>Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.</li> <li>Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.</li> <li>End-to-End Partner Ownership: Ability to own the implementation-partner lifecycle end to end — from onboarding and enablement through co-selling, delivery, and ongoing partner management.</li> <li>Partner Enablement: Ability to build enablement courses and hands-on training, and use dashboards to track progress and drive partner readiness.</li> <li>Vertical &amp; Domain Awareness: Ability to learn a customer's industry quickly and translate domain requirements into product and solution design.</li> <li>Stakeholder Management &amp; Communication: Skilled at managing expectations and building trust across partner, customer, and internal stakeholders, and articulating technical concepts clearly to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.</li> <li>Ownership &amp; Presence: Able to be the trusted technical face in partner and customer calls and scale across multiple engagements at once.</li> <li>Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.</li> <li>Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.</em></p></div>
